images.title: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2, front and back
images.author: unreal-ng
images.terms: vector drawing from measured dimensions; photos used as references only, nothing traced

references.what: plan 153 x 102 mm, height 61 mm (6.02 x 4.01 x 2.40 in)
references.source: retail listings of the Xbox Wireless Controller (pcrichard.com QAU-00090, nfm.com 64696412)

references.what: the outline (trace.py, the half mirrored, overlap 0.995) and the control positions, scaled to 153 mm; front: the faceted D-pad (nine flat facets on a 3 x 3 grid), the cross on its dish with ticks, the stick collars, the profile key under View / Menu, the three profile lights between the D-pad and the right stick, rubber grips, the bumpers and the top strip
references.author: Microsoft
references.use: measured geometry only (trace.py outline, positions); no pixels shipped

references.what: back: the four paddles P1-P4 (P1 / P2 on the right hand, upper / lower), the trigger stops, the charging contacts
references.author: mliu92
references.note: drawn as the pad turned over towards the viewer (triggers at the bottom), so the right hand's paddles stay on the right; positions estimated to about 2 mm

references.what: weight 345 g with the four paddles
